bootstrap.description: No reliable history yet; use channel baseline and low-frequency tests.

cold_start.description: Early account with limited data; test formats carefully.

exploration.description: Validating lanes, hooks, and content formats.

growth.description: Scaling proven lane and format signals.

mature.description: Stable lane and audience; optimize efficiency and quality.

recovery.description: Performance or account health declined; reduce risk and frequency.

restricted.description: Account risk is active; block automated publishing.
